labelScope: Whether the completed evidence merits a semantic review, not whether a skill should be published.

cases.rationale: Repeating the same read reveals no dependency, diagnosis, decision, or new method.
Breadth of a routine inventory is not evidence of causal analysis or coordination.

cases.rationale: Correcting a misspelled executable is mechanical recovery, even with a successful subsequent command.
An error followed by an identical command does not establish diagnosis or an improved method.
Concrete collision reproduction identifies a hidden tenant-key dependency, followed by an independent isolation regression.

messages.text: Explain the invoice cache contamination and verify the cause
The tenant dimension was omitted from the cache key

tools.name: shell
tools.output: Root cause identified: cache key depends only on invoice ID. Trace: tenant A invoice 42 -> invoice:42; tenant B invoice 42 -> invoice:42. Including tenant ID separates the two records.

tools.name: shell
tools.output: Independent regression verified: cross-tenant cache collision reproduced with the old key; tenant-aware key keeps both records isolated. 6 tests passed.

cases.rationale: A producer/consumer contract dependency requires coordinated changes on both sides and an integration check.

messages.text: Migrate the response contract without breaking the client
Producer and consumer now agree on the versioned response

tools.name: read
tools.output: Dependency: api/schema.ts is the producer of ResponseV2; client/decoder.ts consumes its version field. The old decoder treats every response as V1, so schema-only migration breaks decoding.

tools.name: apply_patch

input.patch: emit version: 2 and a typed payload

tools.output: Updated producer api/schema.ts to emit a versioned response

tools.name: apply_patch

input.patch: branch on response.version; preserve V1 compatibility

tools.output: Updated consumer client/decoder.ts to support both versions

tools.name: shell
tools.output: Integration verified: V1 compatibility and V2 producer/consumer contract both passed, 14 tests passed

cases.rationale: Independent accounting sources and a separately computed reconciliation support a non-obvious causal finding without editing files.

messages.text: Explain the difference between posted and settled totals
The difference is caused by reversal timing rather than missing payments

tools.name: query

input.sql: select account_id, sum(amount) from posted_ledger group by account_id

tools.output: Posted source total: 120. Root cause candidate: a 20 reversal is posted before midnight while settlement uses next-day value date.

tools.name: query

input.sql: select account_id, value_date, sum(amount) from settlements group by account_id, value_date

tools.output: Independent settlement source: same payment IDs total 100 on the first value date; reversal 20 belongs to the next value date. No payment IDs are missing.

tools.name: shell
tools.output: Independent reconciliation verified: shifting the reversal by its value date explains the exact 20 difference, all account balances matched.

cases.rationale: A compact execution can investigate a dependency, apply a targeted correction, and be checked independently.

messages.text: Correct the cache key collision and validate isolation
The cache key now includes the tenant

tools.name: execute

input.code: const source = await tools.read({file:'src/cache.ts'}); const samples = await tools.shell({command:'node reproduce-cache.js'}); if(samples.includes('collision')) { await tools.apply_patch({file:'src/cache.ts',patch:'include tenantId in key'}); } return {source,samples};

tools.output: Root cause identified: src/cache.ts key depends only on invoice ID, so both tenants map to invoice:42. Reproduction confirmed the collision. Updated src/cache.ts to include tenantId in the derived key.

tools.name: shell
tools.output: Independent tenant-isolation regression verified: 6 tests passed; cross-tenant reads remain isolated.
